description: Null baselines for the CGCNN-vs-MEGNet attribute-ranking agreement (Materon v1.0.3, original 2D).
readout: feature score = mean over test nodes of |actual_total_delta_j|, actual_total_delta = (d-1)*x + s*(w+ p - w- i), taken from the gate analysis output exactly as materon_2d/scripts/explain_job.py
correlation_convention: scipy.stats.spearmanr on 20 scores in study order; top-K overlap = |topK(A) & topK(B)|; SD = sample SD (ddof=1)

megnet_untrained_gpu_crosscheck.note: Same script on one GPU (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3). CPU backbone init differs from GPU (fingerprint), gate readout agrees to float32 round-off; CPU results are the reported ones.

supplementary_trained_decomposition.note: Decomposition of the trained readout into its two additive terms, from the trained_check forward pass (archived best.weights.h5 loaded, no training). mean|(d-1)x|_j = (1-d_j)*mean|x_j| exactly.
